Command of Vixies

---------------------------------------------


Know ye, disciples of Vixies!  The day draws nigh!  We gather strength.  Soon, we shall bring Vixies to the Realmz.  The great sacrifice must be made.  When enough power is attained, Vixies shall appear in the guise of a holy noble.  She shall be a worldly woman of great physical strength and power.

Those who oppose the mighty Vixies shall be altered into spider form.   Doom will enshroud all puny kingdoms that dare to resist.

The time draws near!  She has already sent her most trusted aid to begin the preparations for her arrival.  The "Widow of the Web"  demands the sacrifice of Vixies' most loyal priestess.

Most honored of human disciples!  You shall be the vessel for my rulership of the Realmz.  You shall be sacrificed and sealed in the holy tomb with Vixies' spiders.  Once Vixies' spiders have consumed the flesh from your body, your skeletal figure shall be taken to the Widow of the Web.  Only then shall the ceremony take place to summon Vixies to the Realmz.

Until the time draws near, the Widow of the Web shall await nearby in a secret cavern she has prepared for the ceremony.

You shall live forever as a martyr to the cause of Vixies.

Sacrifice of Lim Dur

--- Know ye the legend ---

It's been said: 

Only through death can eternal vigilance be achieved.
Those who fail to perform in life shall devote an eternity to duty in death. 

Seek not to walk the planes of light or darkness until you learn the legend of Lim Dur.

And the elder ones were rent with fear
Our father Enki
Lord of Magick
Receiving word by Ninshubur
Ishtar's servant Ninshubur
Queen of the Rising of the Sun
And Enki summoned forth clay
And Enki summoned forth water
To mold the bodies of our future selves

Only through togetherness can you win release
To do otherwise is to invite death and torment
An eternal pain for which there can be no end

Report on body collection

Reported by Lieutenant Vestron
Royal Comander of 22nd Lancers

--- March 12th this year our lord 2235 ---

Body Count to Date

Brystol Mire Graveyard...........27 bodies    

Cragenwood Estates...................12 bodies     
																																		
Whitewater Falls.......................19 bodies     

Bywater Memorial Gardens.....87 bodies

 
Report Summary:

Sire,

By your command, we collected as many bodies from the surrounding graveyards as we could find.  Your agent is of the opinion that a minimum of five hundred corpses are needed to overthrow the accursed tower. I fear that the agent may be overstepping the requirements of your commission.  He has grown ever more abusive and insists that we provide him with fresher corpses.  Sire, I assure you that if they were any fresher, they would not need his foul magic to walk about!  Next, he will be demanding that we slaughter the poor street beggars in order to supply him with what he desires.

The collection process goes well.  However, corpses from our collection have been mysteriously disappearing.  I originally attributed the problem to omnivorous scavengers.  However, the curious absence of bones implies that they were not picked clean by carrion feeders.  While transporting the last batch of dead, I thought I spied a lurking ghoul. I am not certain about this, but the incident has troubled me deeply.  

I grow increasingly tired of this duty and would like to apply for a transfer.  Lately, I have been haunted by evil dreams.  If   you wish for me to continue this task, I shall do so to the best of my ability.  I merely ask that you please give my request some consideration. 

Lieutenant Vestron
Royal Comander 22nd Lancers
